title: 安静的三楼阁楼  (The Sunny Attic)

segments.t: Up under the wooden eaves on the third floor, Chen unlocks the attic study for Qing while Mei climbs up carrying fresh towels. Listen to the whole scene first.
哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
给我们十五分钟，阁楼比七号房还好！
老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
Now let's walk through each key line together.
听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
'Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!' Warm homey atmosphere in two syllables:
温馨
blends physical warmth with a welcoming, cosy feeling.
干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
'Dry, warm, and quiet. Tell me quickly what is still missing.' Handy inspection word:
缺
means 'lack' or 'be short of', ideal when checking what a room still needs.
好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
'Okay: there is a bed, a table, and a chair, yet no bedside lamp.' Location compound
床头
literally 'bed-head', names the bedside spot where a reading lamp belongs.
墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
'No mirror on the wall either, and the floor feels bare without a rug.' Notice
地毯
built from 'ground' plus 'blanket'—a rug is simply a blanket spread across the floor.
楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
'Downstairs in my workshop there is a brass desk lamp.' Lamps take a special literary-sounding counter,
盏
originally a tiny shallow cup that held lamp oil.
隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
'What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?' Polite everyday word for bathroom:
洗手间
literally 'wash-hands room', used everywhere in hotels and restaurants.
上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
'Put in a new bulb last week, with clean soap and plenty of hot water.' Compact calendar word:
上周
puts 'previous' before 'week' for 'last week'.
给我们十五分钟，阁楼比七号房还好！

'Give us fifteen minutes and the attic will be even better than room seven!' Adding 'still' before 'good' in a 'than' comparison boosts it to 'even better than room seven'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
干燥、暖和、安静。快说还缺什么。
好：有床、桌子和椅子，可是没有床头台灯。
墙上也没镜子，地上没铺地毯有点空。
楼下我的工具房里有一盏铜台灯。
储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
上周刚换了新灯泡，有干净肥皂和热水。
给我们十五分钟，阁楼比七号房还好！
老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
拐弯小心点，别碰到墙！
With timber beams and rain pattering on the roof, the attic only needs a lamp, two pillows, and a rug. See you next time as they race the clock.
下次见！
